note: FNS 1063.1 is entirely a QC review procedure, not caseworker policy. It describes the Comparison I / Comparison II framework that QC reviewers use to determine whether income errors occurred during the first and second effective months of a certification. The concepts of 'Comparison I allotment test,' 'Comparison II corrected worksheet,' 'error threshold,' and 'AORD review date' are audit methodology — they instruct reviewers on how to evaluate whether the eligibility worker's actions were correct, not how workers should process cases. The underlying caseworker-facing policies (prospective budgeting, income calculation using four consecutive weeks, BEACON prospective income entry) ARE covered in the OLG under 'Types of Earned Income > Income from Steady Employment,' 'Entering, Changing, and Ending Earned Income in BEACON > Prospective Tab,' and related pages. But the QC testing framework itself has no caseworker equivalent and would not be expected in the OLG.
